coreRule: capability justified by admission policy -> use. NEVER 'capability available -> default use'.

capabilities.why: execute a decomposed multi-phase task with dependency ordering, lease discipline and per-node review
capabilities.when: admission profile requires graph execution (STANDARD and above; fast path bypasses)
capabilities.who: controller (entry), admission (profile), graph_node runtime
capabilities.where: host graph runner or Colima graph runner
capabilities.how: graph IR (from decomposition) + admission result as the envelope authority; scheduler consumes admission's node-role grants and repair budget
capabilities.whenNot: fast path tasks (direct execution); read-only single-node tasks; anything where graph overhead is unjustified

capabilities.why: bound read-only exploration/analysis with minimal context and structured result; research gate
capabilities.who: graph_node (readonly-analyst role), admission (research gate), decomposer (pre-decomposition discovery)
capabilities.where: host (default) or Colima when host trust lower
capabilities.how: envelope with READ_ONLY tool permissions only; result schema-bound; identity-bound
capabilities.whenNot: fast path; tasks whose classification evidence is already sufficient; any need for writes (use writer)

capabilities.why: isolated, scope-enforced code mutation with reviewable diff and no main-tree pollution
capabilities.when: writer_allowed AND isolated_worktree_required OR independent_review_required OR high/medium risk
capabilities.who: graph_node (writer role), admission (writer grant), writer adapter
capabilities.where: dedicated git worktree rw /work; source ro /src; Colima container
capabilities.how: mutationScope from admission (authorized paths); envelope carries worktree identity + repair budget + cancellation identity; fail-closed on any violation
capabilities.whenNot: read-only admission (writer DENIED); fast path in-place edits; tasks with no mutation

capabilities.why: independent verification that a writer's output matches claims; never trust self-report
capabilities.when: independent_review_required (MEDIUM+ writers, HIGH/CRITICAL always, governed code)
capabilities.who: reviewer role (independent review agent), admission (review strength)
capabilities.where: isolated Colima container, read-only mounts (/work /src /results), network none
capabilities.how: structured review result; blockingFindings drive REPAIR or HOLD; review.json persisted
capabilities.whenNot: fast path; deterministic-only verification when no independent review is admitted

capabilities.why: bounded corrective loop on REPAIR with exact blocking findings; never infinite
capabilities.when: a reviewed node returns REPAIR and repair_budget > 0
capabilities.who: graph scheduler, repairer role (writer repair stays in worktree), admission (budget)
capabilities.how: budget = admission repair_budget (capped by effective_repair_cap); attempt journaled; exhaustion -> HOLD
capabilities.whenNot: repair_budget == 0 (fast path: failure -> direct report, no auto-repair)

capabilities.why: hard isolation for untrusted agent processes (network none, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, mount allowlist)
capabilities.who: admission (profile), colima runtime, adapters
capabilities.where: pinned Colima instance; explicit socket; explicit mounts
capabilities.how: mount allowlist (ro source + rw scratch only); limits; idempotent cleanup
capabilities.whenNot: host-side execution when admission allows (fast path, read-only low-risk)

capabilities.why: mutation separated from main checkout; capture + revoke
capabilities.who: writer adapter, admission (isolation policy)
capabilities.how: prepare -> verify -> capture -> revoke; worktree identity bound to result

capabilities.why: prevent parallel mutation conflicts
capabilities.when: any graph with >=1 writer node; parallel read-only workers present
capabilities.who: sealed runner, durable graph layer, admission (concurrency profile)
capabilities.how: lease acquisition per writer phase; fail-closed on violation; resume-safe restoration

capabilities.why: crash-safe execution with journal + checkpoint + resume from durable truth
capabilities.who: durable layer, admission (durability policy), graph runner
capabilities.how: journal at every safe boundary; frozen fingerprint includes admission result (anti-drift)
capabilities.whenNot: ephemeral fast path (crash = restart from scratch is acceptable)

capabilities.why: resume a crashed run to the same state without re-execution or admission drift
capabilities.who: checkpoint bridge, durable layer, admission (frozen in fingerprint)
capabilities.how: publish at safe boundaries; resume verifies fingerprint (admission digest) — mismatch -> HOLD

capabilities.why: deterministic read of prior decisions/architecture context
capabilities.who: graph nodes, sub-agents, research; admission (memory policy)
capabilities.how: bounded queries; retrievalDigest recorded; conflicts surfaced
capabilities.whenNot: tasks with no memory dependency (fast path default: denied)

capabilities.why: persist durable decisions/records through the governed gate
capabilities.when: ONLY when admission explicitly authorizes write-back (memory_writeback_allowed) — default DENIED (CRITICAL-class signal RS.MEMORY_WRITEBACK)
capabilities.who: write-back gate (production), admission (authorization), evidence bindings
capabilities.how: full gate pipeline; trust ladder; idempotent; conflicts surfaced
capabilities.whenNot: fast path; tasks whose results are transient; ANY task not explicitly admitted for write-back

capabilities.why: cost/quality observability; admission quality measurement
capabilities.when: all graph/durable runs; detail level from admission
capabilities.who: graph observer, telemetry index, admission (detail level)
capabilities.how: allowlisted identity-bound events; never secrets
capabilities.whenNot: nothing — always allowed (minimal event for fast path)

capabilities.why: single authoritative external review artifact with full evidence
capabilities.who: closeout gate, admission (evidence level), controller
capabilities.where: authorized outDir only; fixed surface Current/
capabilities.how: state-driven mandatory closeout; inventory consistency; security scan; one-card-one-review-surface
capabilities.whenNot: fast path tasks with evidence_level none

capabilities.why: fixed inbox for the controller/external reviewer; verdict is the receipt
capabilities.who: closeout gate, admission (external review flag)
capabilities.how: atomic publish under lock; occupancy fail-closed; rotate resolved; linear supersede chain

capabilities.why: mandatory persisted closeout state for governed cards
capabilities.who: closeout state machine, admission
capabilities.how: state-driven closeout; disposition idempotent

capabilities.why: harness-owned evidence; never trust self-report
capabilities.who: lifecycle runner, closeout gate, admission (evidence level)
capabilities.how: baseline capture + verification + system delta + digests

capabilities.why: deny-by-default scanning; defense in depth
capabilities.who: all gates
capabilities.how: secret scan, symlink/binary checks, telemetry/memory denylists, pi adapter forbidden args

capabilities.why: authority-scoped lifecycle: commits, push, PR, review units
capabilities.when: any governed card; any commit/push/PR intent
capabilities.who: governance gates, controller, admission (subset constraint)
capabilities.how: admission result is a SUBSET of lifecycle authorization; conflicts -> HOLD

capabilities.why: single canonical risk authority
capabilities.who: admission, ingress points
capabilities.how: canonical enum LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL; fail-closed on unknown

capabilities.why: phase-structured execution plan with explicit effects/evidence policy
capabilities.who: decomposer, admission (depth bound + research gate before it)
capabilities.how: IR v2; execution_policy constrained by admission (no model routing; multi_model_orchestration=false)

capabilities.why: pinned DeepSeek V4 Flash transport with fail-closed payload guard
capabilities.who: transport adapters; NEVER admission (admission must not choose models)
capabilities.how: frozen config; no fallback; no tools by default
capabilities.admissionDecision: NONE — Pi Agent model is fixed (R9); admission only shapes envelope/capability

capabilities.why: atomic state transitions for execution/commit candidates
capabilities.who: durable layer, commit gates, admission (persistence)
capabilities.how: lease -> intent -> discovery -> complete -> current -> release; deterministic ids

enforcementNote: The sub-agent envelope already carries toolPermissions + mutationScope. TA-2 binds the admission result to that envelope so the WRITER cannot gain write capability under a read-only admission (NEG3) and unauthorized capabilities cannot be smuggled in (NEG4). The reviewer adapter already refuses self-declared PASS — admission adds a layer above it.
